answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Signed dragon boat team roster with festival association attestation. It demands a roster the festival association kept across five race seasons, and the whisper is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the knoll is that the farm's unit economics never work. The inlet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
